title: Cute Toddler Girl in Stroller by Vintage Car, August 1955 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid August 1955 black-and-white snapshot photo capturing a curly-haired toddler standing up inside a metal baby stroller outdoors. In the background sits a parked 1950s automobile, offering a charming slice of mid-century suburban American family life. The photo features decorative scalloped borders and an authentic side date stamp reading 'AUG • 55'.
